Definition: a Chittite, or descendant of Cheth
BiblicalUsage: Chittiy is a Hittite, a descendant of Heth, and the name follows Israel from the promise to the monarchy. God lists the Hittites among the peoples of the land He will give Abraham, Ahimelech the Hittite stands with David in the wilderness, and Uriah the Hittite is the man whose wife David takes.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the Hittites remind me that the peoples of the land were never abstractions, and Uriah's name is the rebuke that will not go away. I hold that David's sin against one Hittite is remembered because God counts every person, even the foreigner.
RelatedPeople: Abraham; Uriah the Hittite; King David
